name: Unidirectional Path Tracing
definition: A unidirectional path tracing algorithm that traces rays from the camera, handling surface interactions (BSDF sampling) and volumetric scattering (medium sampling) within a single loop, terminated by Russian Roulette.
summary: Unidirectional Path Tracing evaluates volume illumination by tracing rays from the camera, integrating survival probability checks directly into the main loop rather than using a separate post-loop termination phase.
